blocks.title: Interferometer
blocks.text: Interferometer gravitational waves pakarne mein istemal hone wala optical aala hai. Yeh bohat hassas detection aala hai jo LASER (Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) beams ka interference istemal kar sakta hai. Bunyadi Michelson interferometer Fig. 8.9 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

Gravitational waves pakarne wala interferometer intehai hassas aala hai jo detectors se guzarti gravitational waves se mirrors ke darmiyan faasle mein hone wali bareek tabdeeliyan napne ke liye laser light istemal karta hai. Aise interferometers LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory) kehlate hain. LIGO aur aam interferometers mein bare farq yeh hain: (a) LIGO aam aale se 1000 guna bara hai, aur (b) LIGO laser istemal karta hai jabke aam interferometer mein aam light ka source hota hai.

items: Laser: mustaqil aur zyada shiddat wali light ki beam paida karta hai.
Power recycling mirror: aale se guzar chuki laser light ko musalsal wapas interferometer mein mun'akis karta hai, isi liye recycling ka lafz istemal hota hai.
Beam splitter: laser beam ko do amudi beams mein taqseem karta hai.
Mirrors: beams ko mun'akis kar ke do amudi arms banate hain.
Fabry-Perot cavity: aamne saamne do mirrors par mushtamil; is ka maqsad raste ki lambai barhana hai.
Photodetectors: lautti beams napte hain aur bareek phase shifts, agar hon, pakarte hain.
Arm cavities: laser light barhati hain aur hassasiyat (sensitivity) barhati hain.

blocks.alt: Laser beam ko power recycling mirror se beam splitter tak bhejta hai, jo use oopar aur daen bhejta hai. Har arm mein input mirror aur end mirror hain, aur un ke darmiyan ki beam (surkh) Fabry-Perot cavity banati hai. Daen arm ke input mirror par 'Input mirror' likha hai. Wapas aati beams beam splitter se neeche ek be-label mirror se guzar kar photo detector tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.9: Bunyadi Michelson interferometer (kitab ki Figure 8.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; 'Input mirror' ka label daen arm ke input mirror par lagaya gaya hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laser ki beam beam splitter par do amudi arms mein bat'ti hai. Har arm mein input mirror aur end mirror ke darmiyan roshni bar bar aati jati hai (Fabry-Perot cavity), jis se rasta lamba aur aala hassas hota hai. Wapas aa kar dono beams milti hain aur photo detector interference napta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.9 'Input mirror' ka label beam splitter aur photo detector ke darmiyan wale mirror par lagati hai, aur daen arm ka input mirror be-label chhorti hai. Input mirrors arm cavities ke shuru mein hote hain, is liye yahan label daen arm ke input mirror par hai. Photo detector se pehle wala mirror asal LIGO mein signal recycling mirror kehlata hai; kitab ka text us ka zikr nahi karta, is liye usay be-label rakha gaya hai.

Laser beam do amudi beams mein taqseem hoti hai, har ek interferometer ke do milte julte raston (arms) mein se ek par chalti hai. Beams har arm ke sire par mirrors se takra kar shuruati nuqte par wapas aati hain, jahan woh dobara milti hain. Agar koi gravitational wave guzre to mirrors ke darmiyan faasle mein bareek khalal paida karti hai, jis se dono beams mein phase shift aata hai. Jab beams dobara milti hain to interference pattern banati hain jise photodetector napta hai; gravitational wave ka bareek phase shift interference pattern badal deta hai, aur detector wave ki maujoodgi mehsoos kar leta hai. Michelson interferometer mein interference fringes dikhti hain (For Your Information).

Figure 8.9 interferometer ki sab se saada shakal hai; haqeeqat mein yeh kahin zyada pecheeda hai. 14 September 2015 ko kaainat ki gravitational waves LIGO ne pehli baar dekhin. Albert Einstein ki 100 saal pehle peshgoi ki hui gravitational waves do black holes ke takrao se aayi thin; waves ko USA mein LIGO detector tak pohanchne mein 1.3 arab saal lage. GWs ke mushahide par kaam ke liye Rainer Weiss, Barry C. Barish aur Kip S. Thorne (print mein 'Barisk' aur 'Throne') ko 2017 mein Nobel Prize mila. Team ki ek rukn, Nergis Mavalvala, MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) mein professor, Pakistan se taalluq rakhti hain.

LIGO ki tarah gravitational waves napne ki ek aur sahulat hai jise Virgo kehte hain, jo European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) ke tehat Pisa, Italy ke qareeb Cascina mein kaam karti hai. Virgo bhi interferometer hai jis ke do arms 3 km ke hain, jabke LIGO ke arms 4 km ke hain. Virgo Observatory ka naam Virgo constellation par rakha gaya hai, jo March, April aur May mein raat ke asmaan mein nazar aata hai. Virgo cluster taqreeban 1500 galaxies ka group hai jo taqreeban 5 crore (50 million) light years door hai; ek light year woh faasla hai jo light ek saal mein tay karti hai, taqreeban 9.5 x 10^12 km. Virgo gravitational wave waqiaat pakarne mein shamil raha hai, aur us ki pehli daryaft 2017 mein hui.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ek light year '9.5 billion km' likha hai. Light ki speed 3 x 10^5 km s^-1 aur ek saal taqreeban 3.16 x 10^7 s hai, to ek light year = 3 x 10^5 x 3.16 x 10^7 = 9.5 x 10^12 km, yaani 9.5 trillion (9500 billion) km. Is liye sahi qeemat taqreeban 9.5 x 10^12 km hai.

blocks.title: Example 8.5
blocks.text: Agar gravitational waves ki wavelength 4000 km ho to un ki frequency nikalein. Hal: lambda = 4000 km = 4 x 10^6 m, c = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1, f = ?. Chunke v = f lambda aur v = c, f = c/lambda = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1 / 4 x 10^6 m = 0.75 x 10^2 s^-1 = 75 Hz.

blocks.title: Example 8.6
blocks.text: Ek binary system 10^-1 Hz frequency ki gravitational waves kharij karta hai. In waves ki wavelength kya hai? Hal: f = 10^-1 Hz = 10^-1 s^-1, c = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1, lambda = ?. Chunke v = f lambda aur v = c, lambda = c/f = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1 / 10^-1 s^-1 = 3 x 10^9 m.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves pakarne ka bunyadi tareeqa kya hai, aur unhein pakarne ki kya ahmiyat hai (MCQ 8.12; constructed response 8.5)? Agar gravitational waves ki wavelength 3000 km ho to un ki frequency nikalein (numerical 8.11).
blocks.explanation: Laser interferometry: LIGO jaisa interferometer laser beam ko do lambe amudi arms mein bhejta hai aur guzarti wave se arms ki lambai badalne par bareek phase shift pakarta hai. Gravitational waves pakarna general relativity ki ek peshgoi ki tasdeeq karta hai, taqatwar gravity aur black hole mergers jaise waqiaat parhne deta hai jo kam ya koi light nahi dete, aur kaainat par naya dareecha kholta hai. f = c/lambda = 3 x 10^8 / 3 x 10^6 = 100 Hz.

items: Interferometer: laser beam ko do amudi arms mein taqseem karta, mun'akis kar ke dobara milata hai; guzarti gravitational wave arms ki lambai badal kar phase aur photodetector par interference pattern badal deti hai. LIGO aam interferometer se 1000 guna bara aur laser wala hai.

Ajza: laser, power recycling mirror, beam splitter, mirrors, Fabry-Perot cavity, photodetectors, arm cavities. LIGO 14 September 2015 (black holes, Nobel 2017); Virgo 3 km arms, pehli daryaft 2017. Misalein: 75 Hz; 3 x 10^9 m.
